query:
DELETE FROM chat_messages
            WHERE room_id = $1
              AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
              AND (id, created_at) IN (
                SELECT id, created_at FROM (
                    SELECT id, created_at,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rn
                    FROM chat_messages
                    WHERE room_id = $1
                      AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn > $2::int4
            )
